missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Проект' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Наш' agrees in gender, and 'почти готов' is the short-form predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Проект' is the accusative direct object of 'закончила'; inanimate masculine accusative equals nominative. 'Большой' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Проекта' is genitive after 'нет'. 'Нового' agrees in the masculine genitive, and 'у нас' frames the possession.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Проектом' is instrumental after 'над', the usual way to say working on a project. 'Важным' agrees in the instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Проекте' is prepositional after 'в', marking participation in something. 'Студенты' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Проекту' is dative after 'к', expressing preparation for something. 'Руководитель' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Проекты' is the accusative plural object of 'запускает'; inanimate plural accusative equals nominative. 'Новые' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Проекта' is genitive, showing whose success it is. 'От команды' uses the genitive after 'от'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Проекты' is the nominative plural subject of the short-form predicate 'сданы'. 'Все' agrees, and 'вовремя' adds the manner.
Strategic focus: Genitive after a numeral. 'Проекта' is genitive singular after 'два'. 'На' governs the accusative numeral phrase, and 'деньги' is the subject.
